senses.gloss: अव् vt. 1P (pp. अवित) 1. To defend, to protect, यमवतामवतां च धुरि स्थितः R.ix.1; 2. to do good to, प्रत्यक्षभिः प्रपन्नस्तनुभिरवतु वस्ताभिरष्टाभिरीशः Sak.i.; 3. to please, to satisfy, to give pleasure to, विक्रमसेन मामवति नाजिते त्वयि R.xi.75, i.65; 4. to like, to desire; 5. to favour. (In Pāṇini’s Dhātupāṭha several other senses are given, but they are not met with in classics.)
